name: aitp-atlas
description: AITP Atlas for DeepSeek Harness: one workspace to learn, explore and research physics over AITP notes — the research universe, what waits on you and what is running (agent teams with Oh-My-BBFF), papers and lectures from arXiv and INSPIRE into the library, PDFs with selectable text, LaTeX built beside its PDF with SyncTeX and citations, review of what a discussion changed, search and learning views.
author: Bohan Jia

scripts.test: node build-client.mjs --check && node --test test/atlas.test.mjs test/host.test.mjs test/client.test.mjs test/web.test.mjs test/latex.test.mjs test/review.test.mjs
